verdict.rationale: Wave's own invoicing pages document recurring invoices with automatic or manual billing and automatic credit card payments. Its pricing page documents scheduled overdue reminders sent 3, 7, and 14 days after the due date; one source notes the reminders are a Pro-plan feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth documentation of recurrence schedule options and reminder customization (the reminders are also gated to the Pro tier).

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: Set up recurring invoices and automatic credit card payments for your repeat customers and stop chasing payments.
Send recurring invoices with total flexibility. Switch between automatic and manual billing whenever you want.
Schedule reminders to automatically deploy 3, 7, and 14 days after sent invoices are due, so you don't have to keep chasing customers.
Automatically send overdue reminders with Pro
